graph.name: Brainpower Real-time Video Analytics Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture for streaming video from various devices to perform real-time body language and facial analysis using Kinesis Video Streams, Rekognition, Lambda post-processing, and API Gateway.

nodes.name: WEBCAM FEED
nodes.notes: Video stream input directly from a standard webcam.

nodes.name: VIDEO WEB APP
nodes.notes: Web-based application streaming video into the AWS Cloud.

nodes.name: IOT DEVICES
nodes.notes: IoT edge devices such as AWS DeepLens streaming video.

nodes.name: MOBILE APPS
nodes.notes: Mobile application streaming video using AWS Kinesis Video Streams SDK.

nodes.name: KINESIS VIDEO
nodes.notes: Securely and scalably ingests incoming real-time video streams.

nodes.name: REKOGNITION VIDEO
nodes.notes: Integrated directly with Kinesis Video Streams to detect and track positions, geometries, and locations of faces in near real time.

nodes.name: KINESIS (Raw Stream)
nodes.notes: Receives raw data of labeled faces and positions from Rekognition Video.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Executes custom post-processing algorithms (e.g. calculating rotational/translational velocities and anomaly alerts).

nodes.name: KINESIS (Processed Stream)
nodes.notes: Serves as a conduit for the analyzed and post-processed data.

nodes.name: API GATEWAY
nodes.notes: API endpoint fronting the processed Kinesis data stream for client consumption.

nodes.name: VISUALIZATION DASHBOARD
nodes.notes: Frontend web client pulling from API Gateway to show real-time chart visualizations.
